lines.text: じゃがいもの芽を防ぐのに、りんごが使えるって知ってた？
prompts: a bright cheerful kitchen with a basket of potatoes and a red apple on a wooden table, bright daylight, simple storybook illustration
a red apple next to brown potatoes, bright daylight, cheerful

lines.text: じゃがいもは、置いておくと芽が出てしまいますよね。
prompts: a potato with small green sprouts on a kitchen counter, bright daylight, storybook illustration
a few potatoes in a paper bag in a bright pantry, cheerful

lines.text: りんごは、エチレンというガスを出します。
prompts: a ripe red apple glowing softly with tiny gentle sparkles around it, bright daylight, storybook illustration

lines.text: このガスが、じゃがいもの発芽を抑えると言われています。
prompts: potatoes resting calmly in a box with a red apple, bright daylight, simple storybook illustration
an adult cook looking at smooth potatoes with no sprouts, bright kitchen

lines.text: やり方は、袋や箱にりんごを一つ入れるだけ。
prompts: an adult hand placing a red apple into a paper bag full of potatoes, bright daylight, storybook style
a cardboard box with potatoes and one apple in a bright pantry, cheerful

lines.text: ただし効果は絶対ではないので、時々チェックしてくださいね。
prompts: an adult cook checking a potato in a bright kitchen, soft daylight, storybook illustration
a cool dark-free pantry shelf with a basket of potatoes and an apple, bright and cheerful

lines.text: フォローして、次の雑学も受け取ってね！
prompts: a cozy bright kitchen with a basket of potatoes and an apple and a gentle smile, storybook illustration, bright daylight
